requirements: Access to Vorkath's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Weak to stab melee and ranged; the dragonbane Dragon hunter crossbow is the most effective ranged weapon, the Dragon hunter lance the melee-method weapon.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.
Use listed secondary weapons only where their combat style or phase role is relevant.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Weak to stab melee and ranged; the dragonbane Dragon hunter crossbow is the most effective ranged weapon, the Dragon hunter lance the melee-method weapon.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Weak to stab melee and ranged; the dragonbane Dragon hunter crossbow is the most effective ranged weapon, the Dragon hunter lance the melee-method weapon.

methods.label: Ranged dragonbane kill
methods.summary: Use Dragon hunter crossbow or blowpipe ranged methods with full dragonfire and venom protection.
prayers: Protect from Missiles or Magic depending method
steps: Enter with dragonfire protection, venom protection, and the selected ranged weapon.
Use Dragon hunter crossbow where available because Vorkath is draconic.
Maintain the correct protection prayer and offensive ranged prayer.
Use Salve amulet variants where they fit the setup.
risks: Venom and high ranged or magic hits can stack quickly.

methods.label: Acid, spawn, and fireball specials
methods.summary: Handle Vorkath specials by moving through acid phase, killing the zombified spawn, and dodging one-shot fireballs.
requiredOrKeyItems: Crumble Undead runes or slayer staff autocast
steps: During acid phase, keep walking on safe tiles and avoid standing still.
When the zombified spawn appears, cast Crumble Undead before it reaches you.
Move away from the large vertical fireball impact tile immediately.
Resume DPS only after each special is resolved.
risks: The zombified spawn explodes for lethal damage if not killed.
The vertical fireball can one-shot careless players.
